# Coconut Research Center

> A comprehensive research resource documenting the health benefits, nutritional properties, and therapeutic applications of coconut and coconut oil.

The Coconut Research Center provides evidence-based information on coconut's role in traditional medicine and modern nutritional science. The site focuses on the health benefits of coconut products, particularly coconut oil, and their potential applications in treating various health conditions.

## Key Topics

- Cocos nucifera
- coconut oil
- coconut health benefits
- traditional medicine
- functional food
- nutritional properties
- healing properties
- medical research
- influenza
- herpes
- candidiasis
- Pacific Islander populations
- Asian populations

## Health Benefits & Research

- [Coconut Research Center](https://coconutresearchcenter.org): Homepage covering coconut health benefits and research, featuring information on coconut oil's therapeutic properties and nutritional value
